Because the land is small and mixed with other crops, I will use manure if I can get it, but I will not buy much chemical fertilizer. I will plant the local seed I trust, weed by hand, and I do not expect to irrigate because I depend on the rains. My family will do most of the work, but I may pay a little help for heavy work.
